Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 36, "heading": "VI\nEFFET QUE PEUVENT PRODUIRE SEPT JURONS EN PLEIN AIR", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u036-b0030", "target": "— Идём пить, — сказал Жеан.", "source_sha256": "9c2232d51c2381aba2228914dddf215ed23d57fd40eef534f5c99707f426d9cd", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u036-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "de9d5404eb04d57aee074eee52779ec8f207905d45c88c127e9bb9d7231bb03c"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u036-b0031", "target": "— Куда пойдём? — спросил Феб. — [[I]]В «Яблоко Евы»?[[/I]]", "source_sha256": "080e064213fe1e38b57d9ae38dd04a2f0b1794c801669c532b48fae532aa600d", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u036-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "b32b64df403fbe37f8c6774ef69ef228aad40d489b647251a7272941f06530bd"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 7, "chapter": 6, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u036-b0032", "text": "—Non, capitaine. Allons à [[I]]La Vieille Science[[/I]]. Une vieille qui scie une anse. C'est un rébus. J'aime cela.", "sha256": "fbd4c52d91a3946fab69e9914ca4c3da2af706f777f968273c39d03ff93d81a2", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2050], "source_xml_sha256": "9beacb3f659b258ca6a2a3dd035572f5d0711c87d046bb4324507ec4d5225cdc", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0033", "text": "—Foin des rébus, Jehan! le vin est meilleur à [[I]]La Pomme d'Ève[[/I]]. Et puis, à côté de la porte il y a une vigne au soleil qui m'égaie quand je bois.", "sha256": "2c5d3264030ebfc9a5c3847d0af7018ce91c19b2ec19bf06e05bf024e2d76776", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2051], "source_xml_sha256": "f826d0afcfd6d77de38d6d4bd4318962619e351810cd2d45b4c107cfad8723a7", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0034", "text": "—Eh bien! va pour Ève et sa pomme», dit l'écolier; et prenant le bras de Phoebus: «À propos, mon cher capitaine, vous avez dit tout à l'heure la rue Coupe-Gueule. C'est fort mal parler. On n'est plus si barbare à présent. On dit la rue Coupe-Gorge.»", "sha256": "238d5b24496d8e7e65ef9dde6385e270ea2bc688049432c5b18b76af787d05f0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2052], "source_xml_sha256": "148fca720fbdea6b5ccf60e1cbc96c395db4d4aeebb306e2b03c2e3957ced8f9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0035", "text": "Les deux amis se mirent en route vers [[I]]La Pomme d'Ève[[/I]]. Il est inutile de dire qu'ils avaient d'abord ramassé l'argent et que l'archidiacre les suivait.", "sha256": "eef3652b63c157798377747cdc3267084a2529a5c8516fe8e833add2bcad5ca6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2053], "source_xml_sha256": "a6b3f89872fdb37e2c36d74ec4d55b7438f82f1a9e529d415b2172b07bfbba97", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0036", "text": "L'archidiacre les suivait, sombre et hagard. Était-ce là le Phoebus dont le nom maudit, depuis son entrevue avec Gringoire, se mêlait à toutes ses pensées? il ne le savait, mais, enfin, c'était un Phoebus, et ce nom magique suffisait pour que l'archidiacre suivît à pas de loup les deux insouciants compagnons, écoutant leurs paroles et observant leurs moindres gestes avec une anxiété attentive. Du reste, rien de plus facile que d'entendre tout ce qu'ils disaient, tant ils parlaient haut, fort peu gênés de mettre les passants de moitié dans leurs confidences. Ils parlaient duels, filles, cruches, folies.", "sha256": "96fa977c557555691d7e2f6a3c8a8be4bfa0f0abdf682f1dcb32f8ca1440f0f0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2054], "source_xml_sha256": "3454c9335bae8980bbe35cc6a418fbeec8f663fb902bcb9fe5c3e4c0638814c9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0037", "text": "Au détour d'une rue, le bruit d'un tambour de basque leur vint d'un carrefour voisin. Dom Claude entendit l'officier qui disait à l'écolier:", "sha256": "0ceab5a1aa840b4817f13e01132ef5810e7a86bb8dd24a6469984dabfc5eccbc", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2055], "source_xml_sha256": "fcc327c3934658bb4d2eb374ee4d4d8b4a8ca77335f5ab1aa12ef2272513cdd9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0038", "text": "«Tonnerre! doublons le pas.", "sha256": "eb0427a21cd1dd0470935425de704a698d92e883a271c1963cc1fc0d15cca6d9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2056], "source_xml_sha256": "580ed8c6aee388f6814f1be5fc3e66208bd05ba69a67dfdd9a51cde007055cf3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0039", "text": "—Pourquoi, Phoebus?", "sha256": "98e7c4f5321fe67a1a3b00f998bbadc09a8c463292fef12363c8908575087001", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2057], "source_xml_sha256": "e7d78756c4fba27c74256f48a2dc70f781958cc1f1bd3beb3e91104294806024", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0040", "text": "—J'ai peur que la bohémienne ne me voie.", "sha256": "d608c031abc548ee811a7449d0836385ba4f543de511972767edec88446ff554", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2058], "source_xml_sha256": "d4281b3e54bb72a0bc7b654053bf6c33390b6e8eed0374c7d5e2de488c7e5189", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0041", "text": "—Quelle bohémienne?", "sha256": "7fff4bdde94c70003ac4dbb700a0acbfda22dcdabec76c7281166918c561e109", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2059], "source_xml_sha256": "c88365d8cc9f7d61c8c463833e686f850353fd6e0f8c73440daa62078fd07803", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0042", "text": "—La petite qui a une chèvre.", "sha256": "1d5d142ce55356845249d0a2f487b4b47d143f9ae16f2d555bd0bb40965ca25e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2060], "source_xml_sha256": "bb0b7095d2a833565862d5c27734fc687a69072e4ccf958628fbe137fad53ade", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0043", "text": "—La Smeralda?", "sha256": "124131b87a19158daf06142f620e76773853352476261953e271d5813228fc91", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2061], "source_xml_sha256": "e1794bea833f804523e879287ff88d7338bce15fdf5d0ec9d5f005016f6aa770", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0044", "text": "—Justement, Jehan. J'oublie toujours son diable de nom. Dépêchons, elle me reconnaîtrait. Je ne veux pas que cette fille m'accoste dans la rue.", "sha256": "bf0fc27b26c266c0ab8365041cddcae9efeb90beaf63b17d9f91bc9a3ce6d4e4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2062], "source_xml_sha256": "842cdba2ed59e11a0f012acaaf6aff929557d6f2b79e63d83b6a850cccadadf7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0045", "text": "—Est-ce que vous la connaissez, Phoebus?»", "sha256": "e2cb30e015984ec8254d1d60e3d55ff4019f0e10ac87bff9c8ccd57cfa913704", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2063], "source_xml_sha256": "f13f585c0387a9fb866a70bef6fae4fbc6edcdd7ad1d46712c15ee1559718374", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0046", "text": "Ici l'archidiacre vit Phoebus ricaner, se pencher à l'oreille de Jehan, et lui dire quelques mots tout bas. Puis Phoebus éclata de rire et secoua la tête d'un air triomphant.", "sha256": "c744e0f8dd0bb5ef301656bf24dbe0da8aab00b5c5707ce1435492d402255d5e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2064], "source_xml_sha256": "9176124de37b2c99236c99309ced6a4722c47ba50a5671590185b1c829eacbe5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0047", "text": "«En vérité? dit Jehan.", "sha256": "e9b0f13430e983ec5ef4c336355ee4a87a8119473b9de25dff40995044b6e785", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2065], "source_xml_sha256": "bd7a74ef8ec8ed87016b8b3670cc982fbb678ba54317add6de5b00ba71a076f8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0048", "text": "—Sur mon âme! dit Phoebus.", "sha256": "0cf45ec7aac3c0994b2b12a9aa4f356fcbf2519a44704814305abed04f5ca096", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2066], "source_xml_sha256": "4c28889f03b88620992e204b48f92ee847e41a42a1197a9d118da1043d96ed5b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0049", "text": "—Ce soir?", "sha256": "8445652af0449c5d09ee45e725d3c3c87bebce045d34ef5f26fc37d58d048f9a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2067], "source_xml_sha256": "8a50b8babecbbc96dbb7bbc404180a4a30735454bcd2e16cc292276f3b61a866", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0050", "text": "—Ce soir.", "sha256": "04cc1ac846b7b8b8511a51576650f99607856cc113c456004f4b12bda649182d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2068], "source_xml_sha256": "b77b8f3a546dd35adb8622e0688e63ccbdf44f362435e74de45ac9bca8863b18", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0051", "text": "—Êtes-vous sûr qu'elle viendra?", "sha256": "4df5089ce877947b03d1ccf507a46239b3dffc55b66a2709ca8a049888e707dc", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2069], "source_xml_sha256": "5f720f72f7385f683b6b9d8ef0b3a304f8b5db6b9bd844465e71aca3b92236a7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0052", "text": "—Mais êtes-vous fou, Jehan? est-ce qu'on doute de ces choses-là?", "sha256": "fbd70a54db8bd27ca8a1bd753870718c8d9f3338457523567176104d74cd3dd4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2070], "source_xml_sha256": "9aaca6612ec4907806f319a148f38e12bff62d0b445dcabeda636feaa122d29d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0053", "text": "—Capitaine Phoebus, vous êtes un heureux gendarme!»", "sha256": "ecc15d0d1fe28b895402bce3df15b4d8941718bac1ba93cbd3cd62757e576876", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2071], "source_xml_sha256": "1251460b00cc2ba3f31446588c89433aac2d89a09332fd25045e39c3d049568e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0054", "text": "L'archidiacre entendit toute cette conversation. Ses dents claquèrent. Un frisson, visible aux yeux, parcourut tout son corps. Il s'arrêta un moment, s'appuya à une borne comme un homme ivre, puis il reprit la piste des deux joyeux drôles.", "sha256": "71952ed21d97ef965d90fe156ab4c44b2820cc2f6473e5ffcdc40388f7843308", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2072], "source_xml_sha256": "058622230fc5683ed2f32e2a185bd899bd03132954bd4fde80c399840021e559", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0055", "text": "Au moment où il les rejoignit, ils avaient changé de conversation. Il les entendit chanter à tue-tête le vieux refrain:", "sha256": "1113dc5fec96d8b5ac731e76d73cb78df335996c0760a47f53cf6cec3c2cbf5c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2073], "source_xml_sha256": "426534ccd71fe99015b61e38f8d246925326fbd514f4dfe692b24aa9c2d74a2b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0056", "text": "Les enfants des Petits-Carreaux", "sha256": "0e04d9699060530df2faaec4174d665524f979739efda32c2858a89a5bb16d6e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2074], "source_xml_sha256": "f86eb9c3cf440405ce508d1ba224fc8907d6dee229adaab47f3ccdd373281fa8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u036-b0057", "text": "Se font pendre comme des veaux.", "sha256": "08144cb5de3e7a0785a34002bfdae02e6894e422ecfd0fe61580610e5698e1a3", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2075], "source_xml_sha256": "8787f0492ce57cb9392dd8387632c238be7ec3bbcd8a9ab42a2f4d3ed44c7208", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
